notes.title: Bioframe's Ecosystem is TOO Dynamic?
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=BhZfPKa_uUo;full][/previewyoutube]

In the first of many OSP developer deep dives, Rudolf investigates a problem created by the emergent and dynamic ecosystem of Bioframe Outpost.

When designing a game as dynamic as Bioframe, it was inevitable that eventually we would encounter some unexpected side effects, and in this video we take a close look at one of these unexpected outcomes and discuss the game design lessons that can be learned from it.

notes.title: Bioframe Outpost is out now!
notes.content:
Please join us in our excitement as we announce that Bioframe Outpost is out now on all major platforms. Bioframe Outpost is a 2d sci-fi action adventure metroidvania game that focuses on exploration and experimentation through the use of photography.

Explore Nova Aurora in Bioframe Outpost, the newest game from Eufloria co-creator Rudolf Kremers, and check out our awesome launch trailer.

[previewyoutube=mQjdUfS7JbE;full][/previewyoutube]

Inspired by classic 70s and 80s sci-fi, Bioframe Outpost is a 2d sci-fi action adventure game, dedicated to exploration, experimentation, emergent gameplay and narrative. Its unique, photography-based approach to non-linear exploration and action gameplay offers a fresh take on Metroidvania gameplay.

Use photography to learn how creatures and systems behave while you work to remove an alien infestation. Discover a hugely detailed and fascinating ecosystem, but beware the danger ahead. Unlock secrets on how creatures interact, how you can pit them against each other and even how to use them as weapons or pickups by filling your “Compendium” with vital knowledge. Only you can set them free!

Explore the immense universe of Nova Aurora and unleash your ingenuity and creativity to solve captivating, challenging puzzles.

We are excited to announce that the demo for [b]Bioframe Outpost[/b] is out now, ahead of its launch on November 7th, 2024! Dive in and explore the intricately designed and mysterious world of Nova Aurora and learn how to interact with its sophisticated ecosystem. 

A new gameplay trailer, offering an in-depth look at Bioframe Outpost’s core mechanics and its mysterious ecology, can be viewed here

In addition, we are thrilled to reveal a renewal of its much-loved, Bafta nominated franchise Eufloria. Set to launch imminently on Steam, [b]Eufloria Classic[/b] will bring back the original charms of the long-unavailable indie classic, updated for a new age with a plethora of new content and features, including [b]extreme moddability[/b]. The release marks the return of the Eufloria genus, with more original titles currently under development. Head to store page and wishlist now!
